voice-acting-prompts → best-of-64 by emotion (pilot)

What this is (for dummies). the dataset laion/voice-acting-prompts turns out to label every prompt with one of the 40 Empathic-Insight emotions plus a vocal burst — so a fully procedural pipeline works (no language model needed): strip the [bracket tags] from the prompt to get the text to say, and build the instruction from the emotion's own synonym list + the vocal-burst description + the amplifiers that won our emotion-prompting study (escalation arc + loudness). all lowercase.

Ranking: each group has 64 takes, scored and ranked by reward = invWER × ( 1.5·norm(target emotion) + norm(genuineness) + norm(vocal-burst blend) ) — the intended emotion weighted slightly higher, exactly as specified. below: the top-3 of 64 per group with all scores.

Feasibility verdict: yes. ~1,700 usable texts per emotion (enough for 100 prompts x 40 emotions many times over); the intended emotion maps 1:1 to the EI-Plus scoring heads; extraction is a two-line regex. full run 40 emotions × 100 prompts × 64 takes = 256,000 clips ≈ 60–75 A100-hours ≈ 8–9 h on this 8×A100 box, yielding 12,000 top-3 clips.

vap_Anger_0burst: Teeth chattering (from cold or extreme fear)64/64 takes · best reward 1.62 · mean invWER 0.80
SAY: Damn them all to the deepest circles of oblivion; their treachery will be repaid tenfold! This shivering is not fear, but the prelude to a storm of vengeance that will consume them all.
procedural instruction

extremely anger rage fury hate irascibility enragement vexation wrath peevishness annoyance. starts already emotional and escalates line by line until the feeling completely takes over. includes this vocal burst, performed fully: teeth chattering (from cold or extreme fear). loud, intense, high quality recording.
